pattern: Home saves durable memory in its own folder instead of where the user's instructions say
experience: Home's built-in instructions told it to keep notes in its folder, so durable facts landed there instead of the user's single memory store.
rule: Home: your folder is scratch space; keep durable knowledge where the user's instructions say.

source.design: Home memory audit, 2026-11-19: the user's own memory store is the single source of truth; Home's folder is scratch.

pattern: a thread agent passes a note to a busy Home by hand with t3_thread_send
experience: An outside agent took four read calls and about seven minutes to find Home's thread, then reached it with t3_thread_send, whose default auto mode steers a busy Home's running turn.

source.design: t3_home_send, 2026-11-19: outside agents and thread agents message Home through one tool that finds its thread and folds a message into a busy Home's turn at its next tool call.
